why: Both advisors correctly push back on refusing out of fear. Advice 2 is more accurate: it gives the right churn impact of about ¥30k per month and notes that 1,200万円 would be about 25% of revenue from one customer. It also asks whether the ¥12M recurs every year or is paid only once, and suggests using the prepayment to hire a contractor. Advice 1 has sharper deadlines and thresholds, but it misstates the churn impact, calls the delay the only real cost, and dismisses the asker's fear as groundless.
